dossier.scp_unleashed.163.title: An Old Castaway
dossier.scp_unleashed.163.caption: SCP-163 aboard its craft, beside SCP-163-1.

page.title: Special Containment Procedures:
text: SCP-163 is to remain aboard its craft or within a cleared perimeter around the crash site. SCP-163-1 is not to be moved without cause.
**If SCP-163-1 must be relocated, SCP-163 is to be moved with it, and never left behind.**
Personnel are to treat SCP-163 with courtesy. It does not attack, but it remembers rough handling. Its suit may be removed for examination and is to be returned promptly afterwards.

page.title: Description:
text: SCP-163 is a large, many-limbed organism of unknown origin, roughly the height of an adult. Its skin is pale green and faintly translucent, and the pale lines of an internal frame show through it in good light. Eight jointed legs carry a rounded lower body, from which rises an upright trunk. A broad band of dark compound eye wraps fully around the upper trunk, and above it sits a soft, fleshy dome.

SCP-163 has two pairs of manipulators: a long, delicate upper pair with fine fingers, and a short, heavy lower pair ending in broad friction pads. A small circular maw sits low on the front of the body, with two slender feeding appendages beneath it.

SCP-163 arrived in a crashed craft of a smooth white material resembling metal. Aboard were SCP-163 and four objects: SCP-163-1, a humming canister that SCP-163 keeps close to at all times; a sealed hazmat suit fitted to SCP-163 and worn by it; a console of glowing keys; and a slender signalling instrument.

SCP-163 is curious, patient and peaceful. It spends long periods at the console and the signaller, and it greets personnel who approach it calmly. Now and then it inspects its surroundings, tapping at walls and peering upward.

page.title: Addendum 163-1: Expression
text: The dome above the eye band is the most readable part of SCP-163. It lies smooth when SCP-163 is at ease, gathers into stacked ridges when it is distressed, and pulls down into a deep furrow when it is angry.
A rapid beating of the delicate manipulators has been read as approval. A beating of the heavy manipulators, often against the floor, as disapproval.

page.title: Addendum 163-2: Survey Log
page.text: During the first survey a technician carried SCP-163-1 out of the craft to photograph it. SCP-163 followed at once. Some way beyond the crater it began to labour for breath, and it did not settle until the canister was set down again. %rThe distance involved is withheld.%r

page.title: Addendum 163-3: Field Note
page.text: It took the apple I offered and fluttered its little hands at me. It dislikes losing its suit, but once it has satisfied itself its surroundings are secure it hardly seems to mind. Give it back gently.

item.scp_unleashed.scp163_suit.tooltip: A sealed suit with a clear dome helmet, cut for a body with many limbs.
item.scp_unleashed.scp163_suit.details: Belongs to SCP-163. It wears it willingly and misses it when it is gone.
block.scp_unleashed.scp163_hull.tooltip: Smooth white plating, cool to the touch.
block.scp_unleashed.scp163_hull.details: Recovered from the craft of SCP-163. It does not dent, rust or scratch.
block.scp_unleashed.scp163_hatch.tooltip: A pressure hatch from the craft of SCP-163.
block.scp_unleashed.scp163_apparatus.too: A humming canister with a pale core.
block.scp_unleashed.scp163_apparatus.det: SCP-163 keeps close to it. Its core pulses while it is in use.
block.scp_unleashed.scp163_console.toolt: A sloped desk of glowing keys and shifting glyphs.
block.scp_unleashed.scp163_console.detai: SCP-163 tends to it for long stretches. Its purpose is unknown.
block.scp_unleashed.scp163_signaller.too: A slender mast topped with a pale lamp.
block.scp_unleashed.scp163_signaller.det: It sends something upward when used. Nothing has answered.
scp163.scp_unleashed.lead.falling: Something pale is coming down across the sky.
archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp163_crash: Long-range tracking: a slow object is braking in the upper air.
It is not falling like a rock.
Anything aboard may still be alive. Keep it with what it came with.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp163_castaway_s: SCP-163, An Old Castaway: a gentle, many-limbed visitor. It has %s health and %s armour, %s while it wears its suit.
It never attacks. It shows approval and disapproval with its two pairs of manipulators, and it remembers how it is treated.
It does not do well far from home. Its archive file has more.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp163_suit.1: The sealed suit of SCP-163. SCP-163 can be helped out of it by hand, and helped back into it.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp163_suit.2: It is shaped for SCP-163 alone and cannot be worn.
SCP-163-1, found aboard the craft. SCP-163 does not willingly stray far from it.
Its core pulses gently while it is in use. It can be picked up and set down elsewhere.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp163_console.1: Found aboard the craft. SCP-163 tends to it, and seems pleased when others take an interest.
Found aboard the craft. When used, it sends a pale pulse upward.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp163_hull.1: Recovered from the craft of SCP-163. It cannot be made.
